Brightside Studio is a 60-person product design studio with clients across fintech, health and
climate. Since 2014 we have shipped over 300 products and been named a workplace of the year three
times. We believe good design is a team sport and we look for people who agree.

Position: Product Designer
Location: Lisbon, Portugal (hybrid)
Salary: €42,000 - €55,000 a year

Requirements
- 4+ years designing digital products end to end
- A portfolio that shows research, interaction and visual craft
- Comfort working in Figma and design systems

Bonus points
- Motion design skills
